independent_acquisition.open.title: Futures Independent Club Signing Window Opens
independent_acquisition.open.news.body:
KBO opened the player acquisition window for independent clubs playing in the Futures League. The date is tied to two months after the opening day of the league that includes the independent club.

During this period, independent Futures clubs such as the Ulsan Whales can make up to five roster additions through a separate process. Actual acquisition eligibility still depends on each player's contract status and league registration rules.
independent_acquisition.transfer.title: {buyer_team_name} acquire {player_name}
independent_acquisition.transfer.news.bo:
{buyer_team_link} added {player_link} from Futures independent club {seller_team_link}.

The move was completed through the independent-club acquisition window. The transfer fee is ${cash_cost}, with {buyer_team_link} moving quickly to add depth.
